question.html:
A charged particle of charge and mass is initially at rest in a uniform electric field . What will be the nature of its motion once it is released?

  1. The particle will move with constant velocity in the direction of the electric field.
  2. The particle will move with constant acceleration in the direction of the electric field.
  3. The particle will oscillate back and forth around its initial position.
  4. The particle will experience no motion because it is initially at rest.
